title: Philip K. Dick: Reality's Interrogator
description: Paranoia, synthetic souls, and reality undone—five Dick depths.

questions.question: Which Dick novel became the film Blade Runner?
questions.answer: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
acceptedAnswers: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
do androids dream of electric sheep
do androids dream of electric sheep?
choices: The Man in the High Castle
questions.explanation: Dick died in March 1982, months before the premiere. After glimpsing the effects on TV, he said: "It was my own interior world. They caught it perfectly."

questions.question: In Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?, the Voight-Kampff test detects lack of what in androids?
questions.explanation: The novel's test reads blushing and eye-muscle tension as subjects hear about things like a calfskin wallet. Real animals are status symbols, so Deckard's fake sheep is his shame.

questions.question: While writing about empathy in Androids, Dick was a heavy user of what stimulant?
questions.explanation: His 1977 drug novel A Scanner Darkly ends with a memorial list of friends lost or damaged by drugs. One entry: "To Phil, permanent pancreatic damage."

questions.question: After years on amphetamines, in 1974 Dick reported a vision delivered by a beam of what color light?
questions.explanation: Fans call it "2-3-74." After dental surgery, a pharmacy courier's fish necklace "triggered" him. Dick said the beam later warned him his baby son had a hernia, and doctors confirmed it.

questions.question: That pink beam vision led Dick to name VALIS—Vast Active Living what?
questions.explanation: He spent his last years on an 8,000-page journal, the Exegesis. In VALIS he splits himself in two: narrator Phil and "Horselover Fat," Greek "Philip" plus German "dick."
